subject: Request: one-time POC extension & credit concession for Accelerant.ai
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time POC extension & credit concession for Accelerant.ai

Marissa / Aditya,

Quick ask — Accelerant.ai (contact: Elena Morris) has a security and procurement gating item that will push their technical validation timeline well past our default PLG pilot window. They were onboarded 08/01 and the standard complimentary sandbox/POC window is 30 days; engineering/legal require additional time to complete a data residency review and run their integration end-to-end.

Status in brief:
- Pilot started: 2028-08-01
- Primary use-case: multi-tenant prompt routing + embeddings for search
- Current consumption (Aug): 18k tokens/day avg (attached usage report)
- Outcome sought: production deployment within Q1-2029, expected first-year ARR ~$250k if pilot converts

Ask: one-time exception to extend complimentary POC window to 60 days from today and provision an additional $10,000 in free credits to allow them to complete the security validation without quota throttles.

Constraints/conditions we recommend:
- Extension contingent on a signed mutual action plan and a PO commitment (draft attached) within 45 days of approval.
- Legal to add one-sentence addendum clarifying credits expire if no PO by deadline.
- Limit to this single account and flag for review if they request further concessions.

Attachments: Accelerant_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf; accelerant_usage_aug2028.csv

I know this is outside PLG defaults — sharing the commercial upside and recommended guardrails so you have context. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through details.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time POC extension & credit concession for Accelerant.ai

Dylan —

Thanks for the write-up. Couple quick follow-ups before I take to Deal Desk / Exec queue:
1) Confirm expected ACV if they convert (you mentioned ~$250k — is that first-year net, recurring?).
2) What minimal KPIs will they use to validate success (latency thresholds, embedding precision, #queries/day)?
3) Any previous credits/extensions given to Accelerant? I want historical precedents.
4) Legal: please confirm we can ship the addendum (one-line expiration) — I can draft language.

If you can get me those answers by EOD we can push this to Aditya for decision tomorrow morning. If Aditya signs off we typically approve a lower credit amount than ask and we prefer timeboxed extensions (45 days vs 60) unless revenue motion justifies more.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time POC extension & credit concession for Accelerant.ai

Marissa —

Answers inline:
1) Expected ACV: ~$250k ARR first year (net new revenue; they are a net-new customer in our pipeline, forecast BDR -> AE).
2) KPIs: 
   - Mean latency for search rerank < 220ms at 5 qps
   - Embedding avg cosine recall >= 0.86 on the benchmark set
   - End-to-end pipeline stable at 10k requests/day for a 48-hour soak run
3) No prior credits/extensions — this is first ask; pilot consumed standard PLG allotment and requested top-up after internal procurement delays.
4) Legal addendum: I briefly spoke to Legal — they prefer a 1-line addendum tying credits to PO signature by date. If Deal Desk approves, Legal will fast-track the wording.

Additional context useful to decision: their procurement timeline is driven by a regulator in the EU (data residency and logging). Their engineering lead is looping in infra validation next week. If we put an artificial cap (e.g., $7.5k vs $10k) they still can complete the key validation steps; $10k would be comfortable but not strictly necessary.

Proposed compromise: 45-day extension + $7,500 credit, conditioned on signing the mutual action plan and PO commitment within 45 days. If they convert within 120 days, we convert unused credits to a one-time invoice credit (to avoid accounting write-offs).

If that sounds acceptable I can ask Aditya for sign-off.

On Wed, Sep 13, 2028 at 4:22 PM Dylan Brooks wrote:
> Marissa / Aditya,
> 
> Quick ask — Accelerant.ai (contact: Elena Morris) has a security and procurement gating item that will push their technical validation timeline well past our default PLG pilot window...

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time POC extension & credit concession for Accelerant.ai

Team —

Thanks for the clear summary and the proposed guardrails. Given the conversion potential and regulatory lag they face, I approve a one-time exception on the following terms:

- Extension: 45 days from approval date (one-time only).
- Credits: $7,500 of complimentary credits to be added to their sandbox account.
- Conditions: Must sign the attached Mutual Action Plan and provide a PO or signed commitment within 45 days of this approval. Credits will expire if the PO is not received by the deadline.
- Legal: Marissa / Legal to produce the one-line addendum and route to Accelerant with the MAP.
- Finance: Jordan, please note for forecasting — mark as conditional credit that will be written off if no PO within 45 days.
- Escalation: Any request to extend beyond these terms must come back to me with explicit CRO/CFO sign-off.

This is a measured concession to keep the opportunity live while controlling downside. Dylan — please confirm acknowledgement and get the MAP + addendum to Elena today so procurement can act on it.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
